expl: Differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 → 30+12 = 42.

q: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
expl: A doctor works in a hospital; a teacher works in a school.

expl: Only daughter of Sita's mother is Sita herself, so the man is Sita's son.

expl: North 5, East 3, South 5 → he is 3 km east of the start.

q: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 3:00?
expl: Each hour mark is 30°; 3 hours = 90°.

q: If today is Monday, what day will it be after 10 days?
expl: 10 mod 7 = 3 → Monday + 3 = Thursday.

q: A, C, E, G, ?
expl: Alternate letters are skipped: A, C, E, G, I.

q: When is Rajasthan Day celebrated?

q: What is the highest peak of the Aravalli range?
expl: Guru Shikhar at Mount Abu is about 1722 m high.

expl: The Godawan is the state bird.

expl: Maharana Pratap fought Akbar's army led by Man Singh in 1576.

q: In which district is the Harappan site Kalibangan located?
expl: Kalibangan is on the Ghaggar (Saraswati) bed in Hanumangarh.

q: Ranthambore National Park is in which district?
expl: Ranthambore is in Sawai Madhopur district.

q: Who built Kumbhalgarh fort?
expl: Maharana Kumbha built it in the 15th century.

q: The Pushkar Fair is held in which Hindu month?
expl: It takes place around Kartik Purnima.

q: How many members does the Rajasthan Legislative Assembly have?
expl: Rajasthan Vidhan Sabha has 200 seats.

q: The 'Trial and Error' theory of learning was proposed by:
expl: Thorndike's connectionism is based on trial and error.

q: What does CCE stand for?
expl: CCE evaluates the whole child throughout the year.

q: The school structure proposed in NEP 2020 is:
expl: NEP 2020 replaced 10+2 with 5+3+3+4.

q: The concept of the Zone of Proximal Development was given by:
expl: ZPD is the gap between what a child can do alone and with help.

q: The Right to Education Act was enacted in:
expl: RTE Act 2009 came into force on 1 April 2010.

q: Evaluation carried out during instruction to improve learning is called:
expl: Formative evaluation gives feedback while learning is happening.

q: Divergent thinking is mainly associated with:
expl: Divergent thinking generates many different ideas.

q: Operant conditioning was proposed by:
expl: Skinner studied how consequences shape behaviour.

q: The Kothari Commission (1964–66) was headed by:
expl: It recommended the 10+2+3 pattern.

q: Which of the following is a barrier to effective communication?
expl: Noise distorts the message between sender and receiver.

q: A democratic teacher typically:

expl: Democratic leadership values participation.

Give extra attention and suitable support

expl: Ancient means very old; modern is the opposite.

q: 'नमः + ते' इत्यस्य सन्धियुक्तं रूपं किम्?
expl: विसर्गस्य सकारः – 'नमस्ते'।

q: 'नीलकमलम्' इत्यत्र कः समासः?
expl: नीलं च तत् कमलम् – विशेषण-विशेष्य कर्मधारयः।
